svg.title: Fixed laser energy and finite pressure or velocity budgets
svg.desc: Incident Gaussian energy Ep is reduced by absorption eta_abs and energy allocation eta_b or eta_sh. Bubble volume, acoustic distance and pulse width limit conditional estimates.
